# Open and dismiss the Start menu, Paint, and the standard wallpaper viewer.
wait 1200
key win
wait 1400
key esc
key win+r
wait 500
type mspaint
key enter
wait 2200
key alt+space
key m
key right
key right
key right
key enter
wait 700
key alt+f4
wait 500
key win+r
wait 500
type C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg
key enter
wait 3500
key alt+f4
wait 1000
